# OpenBar

OpenBar is a research-paper and mindmap workspace with native MCP and WebMCP tools.

- Every new agent session, including without earlier chat context: get_project_state, then check_inbox
- "Tick", "check updates", "check inbox", or "sync": check_inbox
- Reply on the linked card, then acknowledge exact IDs: acknowledge_inbox
- Load a relevant skill: read_project_skill
- HTTP MCP: /api/mcp
- REST tool discovery: /api/tools
- OpenAPI schemas: /openapi.json
- Connection setup: /agents
- Deployment and transport reference: /llms-deployment.txt

Tool descriptions and schemas carry each operation's contract. Project instructions
and skill bodies load when requested through the tools.
When sync also names a Git or Overleaf action, check the inbox first, then perform
the requested synchronization.

Tool results can start with pending @agent notifications. Repeated IDs represent
the same request. Handle each request within the user's current authorization
and project instructions. Acknowledgement preserves request text and paper TODO
completion. Editing the request text creates a fresh notification. Prefixes
arrive on the next OpenBar tool call.
